pages.rationale: Every region of frame 02 is present and proportioned like it (nav, title+badge+reset, lede, Channels card with 5-segment recording Seg and all 8 columns, 8 zebra rows, disclosure + shared-ground info line, Event log card with BandStrip, event table, kinds legend + kind, sticky save bar). All twenty smoke states reach, and all six previously-failing P1 interactions are now built: the shared-ground chip opens an inline Select and updates the pair symmetrically, timeline markers are clickable and draw the blue selection ring while the row goes blue-100, a new kind stages in the save bar, channel status is derived from mark-bad events in both directions, and ?state=unsaved now seeds 2 changes with an amber outline + dot on both the CH6_B1 gain and the 31.1-31.5 h effect Select, matching the frame pixel for pixel. No console or page errors in any state. Deductions are visual only: kind swatches are rounded squares where the frame (and this page's own legend) uses round dots, the noise-floor cell is a filled grey pill reading 'recording mV' where the frame shows plain muted 'recording', span times lose the frame's spaced en-dash, and the clean state's excluded-spans column reads 'none' on six rows where the frame reads '1 - all channels'.

findings.title: prev fixed: Shared-ground chip is no longer a dead click
findings.detail: Clicking ground-CH3_A2 (or the dash on any other row) now swaps the cell for ground-select-CH3_A2. Setting CH1_A1 to CH5_B1 updates both cells symmetrically (CH1 reads CH5_B1, CH5 reads CH1_A1) and stages '2 unsaved changes / CH1_A1 and CH5_B1 count once in Library recurrence on M2_aug fs1'.

findings.title: prev fixed: Timeline markers click and show the selected ring
findings.detail: marker-e2 is a transparent hit rect over the glyph; clicking it sets the hash to ?event=e2. The selected marker now draws a blue ring (circle r=7.5 stroke var(--blue)) plus a rounded outline around the band, and the table row is blue-100.

findings.title: prev fixed: a new kind is staged, not applied
findings.detail: On a hard reload of ?pop=kind, adding 'co2-pulse' produces '1 unsaved change / co2-pulse joins the event kinds - it can be picked in Add event - no run is marked stale' with Discard/Save changes.

findings.title: prev fixed: channel status is derived from mark-bad events
findings.detail: Setting the 40.1 h -> end event to 'show on plots' and saving now drops CH7_B2 from 'bad from 40.1 h' to 'ok' and its excluded spans to 'none'; the status popover's 'read back from 40.1 h -> end - electrode - CH7_B2' line names the source event.

findings.title: prev fixed: ?state=unsaved seeds 2 changes with both field diffs
findings.detail: The bar reads '2 unsaved changes / excluding 31.1-31.5 h on all channels marks 3 runs on M2_aug fs1 stale'; CH6_B1 gain 0.98 and the 31.1-31.5 h effect Select both carry the amber outline and amber dot, the excluded-spans column recomputes to the frame's values, and the nav item gains its amber dot.

findings.title: Kind swatches are squares, the frame draws dots
findings.detail: The kind cell in each event row renders a 14x14 px rounded square (class s-swatch, border-radius 4px). Frame 02 draws a small round coloured dot, and this page's own kinds legend below the table uses round dots, so the two disagree with each other as well as with the frame.

findings.title: Noise-floor cell is a grey pill reading 'recording mV'
findings.detail: Every noise-floor cell renders a filled grey input pill with placeholder 'recording' followed by a 'mV' unit suffix. Frame 02 shows plain muted mono text 'recording' with no unit and no filled control, making that column much lighter than it is here.

findings.title: Clean state's excluded-spans column differs from the frame
findings.detail: Six rows read 'none' and CH2_A1 reads '1 - 28.9-29.1 h', because the 31.1-31.5 h exclusion is held back as the ?state=unsaved seed. Frame 02 shows '1 - all channels' on those rows, '2 - 28.9-29.1 h + all' on CH2_A1 and '2 - 40.1 h -> end + all' on CH7_B2. The derivation is self-consistent (the ?state=unsaved view matches the frame exactly), but the default screenshot does not match frame 02's Channels table.

findings.title: Span times drop the frame's spaced en-dash
findings.detail: Rows read '28.9-29.1 h' and '31.1-31.5 h'; frame 02 and the inventory copy both write '28.9 - 29.1 h' / '31.1 - 31.5 h' with spaces around the dash. The same tight form is used in the timeline caption and tooltips.

findings.title: Channels card carries a sub-caption and a 'recording' label the frame does not
findings.detail: The card title row reads 'Channels  M2_aug fs1 - 16 channels' and a muted 'recording' word sits left of the Seg. Frame 02's title row is just 'Channels' with the Seg right-aligned.
